As someone who's always on the lookout for products that help with hyperpigmentation, I was excited to try the Peace Out Brightening Dark Spot Patches, which I received complimentary from peaceoutskincare. After a few weeks of testing, I can confidently share my thoughts on these targeted skincare patches. The patches are easy to apply and adhere well to the skin without slipping. I love that they're individually packaged, making them hygienic and travel-friendly. Designed to be worn overnight, they're incredibly convenient for my routine. Each patch contains niacinamide, licorice extract, and tranexamic acid, which are known to brighten and even out skin tone. I appreciate that they target dark spots specifically without having to layer on multiple products. After using these for several weeks on a few stubborn dark spots, I noticed subtle brightening in those areas. The patches didn't completely erase the spots, but they did lighten them enough that they're easier to conceal with makeup. I also liked how smooth and hydrated the treated areas felt in the morning. What I loved most about these patches is their convenience. They're quick to apply and perfect for busy days when I can't commit to a lengthy routine. The formula is gentle, and I didn't experience any irritation, which is a big plus for my sensitive skin. The combination of brightening agents is also impressive and feels well thought out. avis.titre: Works pretty well, alternative to med-spa laser treatment
avis.texte: You have to use these microdots consistently over time, as the instructions say. I have dark spots on my legs from picking at ingrown hairs and I got decent fading after using every day for five days. If you have multiple spots, it gets expensive to buy multiple packages. However, it's way less costly than a laser treatment. I went to an upscale med-spa in my area in California to ask about treatment for my spots, and they wanted to charge nearly a thousand dollars for a laser treatment that "might not work"...
